tagline: A little rise, a lot of love.

flavors.name: Plain
flavors.desc: The original. Organic unbleached flour, reverse osmosis water, unrefined mineral salt, cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil, and a long sourdough rise. Finished with Maldon flakes. Crisp bottom, pillowy middle.

flavors.name: Garlic
flavors.desc: Same dough and the same good ingredients, plus roasted garlic and fresh rosemary pressed into the dimples. The one people ask for twice.

ingredients.name: Organic unbleached flour
ingredients.note: No bleach, no bromate. Just wheat.

ingredients.name: Filtered reverse osmosis water
ingredients.note: Clean water makes a cleaner rise.

ingredients.name: Two sea salts
ingredients.note: Redmond unrefined mineral salt in the dough, Maldon flakes on top.

ingredients.name: Premium cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: Generous on the pan and on the crust.

ingredientsNote: Plus a sourdough starter we've kept alive for a long time, and for the garlic pan, roasted garlic and fresh rosemary. No yeast packets, no preservatives.
